notes.title: Miner Mayhem trading cards have arrived!
notes.content:
We have released the official Miner Mayhem trading cards which are now available on Steam. 

Includes: 
- 8 Unique Trading Cards! 
- 4 Background Themes! 
- 5 Emoticons! 
- Cool Badges to earn! 

Get mining in Miner Mayhem and start collecting the trading cards today!
